notes: Corrected: the accepted alignment kept *any of* whole on the construct numeral `אַחַד`. `אַחַד שְׁעָרֶיךָ` is an ordinary construct chain, so rule 19 puts the relational *of* on the nomen rectum and leaves the construct only its own word; the rule's `כֻּלָּם` → *all of them* paragraph is directly on point and forbids reading the *of* as part of an English quantifier.
`לֹא תוּכַל` is split rather than fused: the ASV writes *mayest not*, two words, which rule 35 says defeats the indivisible `cannot` reading.
Both `לְ`s of the verse (before the infinitive and the dative before the suffix) are `unrepresented`, each because the ASV's recasting writes no word for the relation.
